title: Thurgoona, NSW 2640 - Infrastructure Restoration
current_summary: Services in Thurgoona (NSW 2640) were interrupted due to an unexpected network issue. Field works were completed to repair network cabling and services were restored at 2:57 PM AEST on 24 July 2026. If you are still offline, please restart your modem/router and connection box, then contact us if the issue continues.

updates.content:
We’re aware of an earlier service interruption affecting some customers in Thurgoona (NSW 2640). The issue has been resolved following field repairs to network cabling, and services were restored at 2:57 PM AEST on 24 July 2026.

If your service has not come back online, please restart your modem/router and any connection box you have. If you’re still experiencing issues after restarting, contact our support team and we’ll help get you back online.
